title: A plan settles the implementation choice of an item whose title or text names a gate-class word, so its worker asks no blocking gate
goal: the sprint plan step settles, in the goal of a committed item whose title or text holds a gate-class word (token, mirror, push, secret), the implementation choice a worker would otherwise ask as a blocking gate

run:
import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
s=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('## start',1)[0].lower()
miss=[w for w in ['gate-class word'] if w not in s]
sys.exit('not yet: plan section lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
